<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court directives on electoral integrity:</strong> The Supreme Court ordered the Election Commission to investigate the bulk submission of Form 7 applications for voter deletion during the Special Integrated Revision (SIR) process in Uttar Pradesh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Courtroom video policy:</strong> The Supreme Court directed the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) to incorporate specific penalties and enforcement actions against the unauthorized circulation of live-streamed court proceedings into its proposed policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission timelines:</strong> The ECI has extended the Special Integrated Revision (SIR) timelines for voter roll updates across six states, including Delhi and Maharashtra.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQamQ0czh2NU9uNDdweGdQalVjRkdybWRQVFI1SnNBM2xSWTMxWXJnU0JOSHcwWGpwRzVTZVBFVG96aW5wckpaUFFUaVAxOFlOV3hGbkk0YV9uV25LYy1pcUNrb2lwUjdJNkFMVEp3UERhdDNjdjVOcG01NXE5Mi1LVEZfVHZlaXVVc3NLeEpVN3QxWWwtdjdkdXNpOFhUb1A1djlnaldMSFhVVW5aZEhPTnp1OURxYUVTRzNuS20yTXZHRTBpZkE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
